anomalies.expected: U14 ~RESET should not be held at ground. The companion UART controller U13 has its ~RESET pulled up via R18 (Net-(U13-~{RESET}) : R18.1(passive) U13.5(~{RESET},input)), so U14 should similarly be released from reset, typically with a pull-up to the 3.3 V serial rail or driven by logic.

evidence.quote: The specification does not list U14 reset grounding as a known limitation or intended behavior.

anomalies.impact: U14 is held permanently in reset, so its UART channels and associated serial connections (e.g. RX3/RX4/TX3/TX4 nets and J17/J18 serial paths) will not function as intended.
